summary: Huang argues for broad AI adoption, open models and more infrastructure, and says alarming people about AI risk is irresponsible.

statements.quote: Scaring people is unnecessary. It is irresponsible.
Our company’s success is directly connected to the safe deployment of products and services
Open source is fundamentally necessary for many industries to join the AI revolution.
Every college student should graduate and be an expert in AI.
The choices we make now, how fast we build, how broadly we participate and how responsibly we deploy it, will shape what this era becomes.
